mapper.select: select TEMP.* from ( SELECT A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ A.BRANCH as branch, /**分支序号**/ A.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ A.CCY as ccy, /**交易币种**/ A.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /**交易金额**/ A.PS as ps, /**交易方向**/ A.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus, /**交易状态**/ decode(fin.P_FINPROD_ID,null,fin.FINPROD_ID) as proId, /**理财产品代码**/ D.TASK_ID as taskId,/**任务代码**/ D.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId,/**账套代码**/ D.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate,/**账套日期**/ D.HAPPEN_DATE as happenDate,/**发生日期**/ D.BOOK_DATE as bookDate,/**入账日期**/ M.STANDARD_CCY as standardCcy /**本位币**/ FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO D /**批处理待处理任务表**/ INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET M /**账套**/ ON D.BOOKSET_ID = M.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B /**入账信息表**/ ON ( D.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = B.HAPPEN_DATE AND D.BOOK_DATE = B.BOOK_DATE ) INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A /**金融产品交易**/ ON ( B.BUSI_NO = A.TRADE_ID AND (A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType1} or A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType2} or A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType3}) ) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin /**标的类金融产品**/ ON A.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ext ON ext.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID WHERE D.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND D.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ext.PROFIT_FLAG = #{profitFlag} )TEMP

select distinct B.Vouch_Num from BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL B inner join BOK_VOUCH_MAIN A on A.VOUCH_NUM = B.VOUCH_NUM inner join BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo on todo.bookset_id = A.BOOKSET_ID where B.VOUCH_NUM = A.VOUCH_NUM and A.Book_Date >= #{bookDate} and a.bookset_id = #{booksetId} and A.Trade_Id is not null
